answer_1.quote: In most contexts, it is essential that texts produced by data-to-text Natural Language Generation (NLG) systems accurately communicate input data.
datasets: small corpus of 21 accuracy-annotated sports stories

answer_2.quote: We used our results to measure the effectiveness of the Relation Generation (RG) metric, which uses information extraction and was proposed by  as a way of measuring the accuracy of generated sports summaries.

answer_4.quote: We propose here a methodology (protocol) for high-quality human evaluation of the accuracy of generated texts.
answer_4.guideline: We ask annotators to categorise errors into one of the following categories: Incorrect number, Incorrect named entity, Incorrect word, Context error, Not checkable, Other.
